verification.notes: This is a quotation/attribution check of interviewer Ollie Anisfeld's accusation, not a factual endorsement of the subjective term 'hijack.' The recorded interview excerpt and published transcript reproduce his statement that Owens had chosen to hijack Kirk's death to blame it on Israel.
